source: the model header (Trace conformance) and its SigmaObs/H definitions
hidden: H = diff(Events, SigmaObs): rounds, enable results 0/1, disables, signals, the claims' second word, stale flags, x_xw/w_xw/m_wxw, idle, bounds
projection: one Alternative object with its channels, their partners and, for Part A, the partner Alternative

configurations.name: Part A SYSA
requires: two Alternatives A {c1!, c2?} and B {c1?, c2!} (B's guard order b1), on rendezvous channels c1, c2
no other users of c1, c2

configurations.name: Part B SYSB
requires: A's Alternative is {c0 rendezvous input, c1 buffered input}
c0: one message from a plain writer (PW) or a single-guard ALT writer (AW)
c1: one PutFromISR, no task writer

configurations.name: Part C SYSC
requires: W's Alternative is {c1!, c2!}, both rendezvous output guards
on each channel one reader that reads once: a single-guard ALT reader (AR) or a plain reader (PR)

events.trace: AltSelected (guard g) of A / B / W
events.model: x_sel.x.c.b, a_sel.g.b.o, m_wsel.c.b (x_sel, m_wsel: b = exactly one communication so far / since the previous select, on c; a_sel: b, o = data on g, on the other guard; computed from the RendezvousDone events since the thread's previous AltSelected)
w_done, m_done (b: a RendezvousDone names it on its channel)
x_towait.x.true + x_wait.x, a_towait.true + a_wait, w_towait.true + w_wait, m_wtowait.true + m_wwait, m_rtowait.c.true + m_rwait.c

events.trace: WaitChannel(write) of a plain writer / WaitChannel(read) of a plain reader

events.model: the decision of the pair: x_en.x.c.2, x_claim.x.c, a_en0.2, w_en.2, m_wen.c.2, m_ren.c.2, m_rclaim.c, or the activate that takes or claims the partner (x_act.x.c.3, a_act0.2/.3, m_wact.c.2/.3, m_ract.c.3); which one is not in the trace (gaps)

generator: matching only: the activate events carry the decision but a RendezvousDone does not say whether the pair was claimed earlier or now (model header, Gaps); not generated until a recorded instance matches
gaps: the mapping of the activate events needs a replay of the state words
enable/disable results and state words are not recorded
